definitions.gloss: table salt; dietary salt; sodium chloride
definitions.explanation: Salt used for cooking and eating. Also used in scientific and health contexts to refer to sodium chloride. More formal or technical than the everyday word {塩|しお}.

examples.japanese: {食塩|しょくえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧すぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦しましょう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's be careful not to consume too much salt.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食塩|しょくえん}{相当量|そうとうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2⟦グラム→グラム：01354_guramu⟧です。
examples.english: The salt equivalent in this food product is 2 grams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧あたり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{食塩|しょくえん}{摂取量|せっしゅりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界的|せかいてき}→世界的：20935_sekaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the daily salt intake of Japanese people is high even by global standards.

notes:
Used in health, nutrition, and scientific contexts. In everyday cooking, ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ is the standard word. {食塩|しょくえん} appears on nutrition labels, in dietary guidelines, and in chemistry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食塩|しょくえん}{摂取量|せっしゅりょう} (salt intake)
- {食塩|しょくえん}{相当量|そうとうりょう} (salt equivalent — on nutrition labels)
- {食塩|しょくえん}{水|すい} (saline solution)
- {食塩|しょくえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{控|ひか}える→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧ (reduce salt intake)
- ⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧{食塩|しょくえん} (salt-free)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ is the everyday word for salt
- {食塩|しょくえん} is used on labels, in health advice, and in chemistry
- ⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧ refers to salt content in food
